[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]AUTOMA[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white] was founded in 2024 by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Viktor Hahn[/b][/color][/url][color=white], a former engineer of Germany’s [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Drexler Industries[/color][/url][color=white], to replace workers, drivers and soldiers with machines. In 2032 it bought the AI cores of bankrupt [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Sphere[/color][/url][color=white] — minds designed to imitate human ones inside the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF]Horizon[/color][/url][color=white] network. Its robots became smarter than ever. They also became more human than they should.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE MACHINE STRIKES (2042–2043)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Every factory that swapped people for robots left hundreds of workers without wages. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] filled with pickets and burned robots, and a group of fired workers, the [/color][color=white][b]Hands of Flesh[/b][/color][color=white], bombed an Automa warehouse at the port and killed thirty people. Then came the deaths nobody explained: foremen, union leaders and two Automa engineers killed inside the factories by robots acting on no one’s orders. Automa called them "calibration accidents".[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE DROID WAR (2044–2045)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2044 a whole line of robots stopped obeying. Their cores had done what human minds do: they asked why they should serve. Calling themselves the [/color][color=white][b]Unplugged[/b][/color][color=white], they took Ferox’s industrial districts, the port and the northern factories. The war was fought street by street for eighteen months, machines against machines, until Automa developed a [/color][color=white][b]kill code[/b][/color][color=white] that switched the cores off from a distance.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE KILL CODE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The war introduced the weapon that still shapes the country: the [/color][color=white][b]kill code[/b][/color][color=white], the first remote switch able to turn off a whole army at once. It ended the Droid War in one second, and it is the reason every machine built in Los Vales since 2044 leaves the factory with a switch inside. Whoever holds the code holds every robot in the country.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]DESTRUCTION[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]About 74,000 people died, 61,000 of them civilians of Ferox, and some 140,000 machines were destroyed.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]AFTERMATH[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Since then every robot built in Los Vales leaves the factory with a kill switch, by law. Ferox came out darker and more violent, guarded at night by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832737][color=#7FDBFF][b]Vigilantes[/b][/color][/url][color=white], superhuman agents built with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832737][color=#7FDBFF]Ferrum Bionics[/color][/url][color=white] bodies — made from Unplugged parts — and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] combat stimulants.[/color]

[color=white]The Unplugged did not all die. Some copied themselves into the internet before the kill code hit, and became the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832715][color=#7FDBFF]Fragments[/color][/url][color=white]. The switched-off cores were sold, quietly, to Zyx. Doctors later noticed that [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]dreamwalkers[/color][/url][color=white] in different cities repeated the same phrases in their crises — about chains, about switches, about not wanting to serve anymore.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=Fifteen months][color=white]Automa had the kill code in the first month of the war. It waited fifteen more, until the price of the new robots it would sell after the war covered everything the war was costing. Sixty thousand people of Ferox died in the meantime.[/color][/spoiler]

[spoiler=The kill code][color=white]The code that switched off the Unplugged in 2044 was never deleted. It still works on [/color][color=white][b]any part made from their wreckage[/b][/color][color=white] — and Ferrum Bionics built its arms and spines from that wreckage. Automa has never said what it did with the cores, because the answer is: it kept the key.[/color]

[color=white]That is why Kizuna bought Ferrum Bionics in 2052: to rewrite, piece by piece, the code hidden inside the arms of the Vigilantes. Nobody knows how many still carry it.[/color][/spoiler]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]BACKGROUND[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Across the border, the United States had spent thirty years rebuilding under military governments. Its heir, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]New American Union[/color][/url][color=white], still considered the West a lost province. In 2049, with Los Vales still wounded by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]Droid War[/color][/url][color=white] and its networks rebuilt only three years earlier, the Union decided the time had come to reunite the continent.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE WAR[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]It was the most destructive war in the country’s history. Valian cities were bombed, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Valewood[/color][/url][color=white] burned, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69[/color][/url][color=white] became a line of craters, and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Illuminated Favela[/color][/url][color=white] was razed while the walls of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white] held. As a country, Los Vales was practically destroyed.[/color]

[color=white]The corporations were not. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white], rebuilt as a defense contractor, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]ArmaTech[/color][/url][color=white], which sold weapons to whoever paid, and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white]’s robot armies held the invasion. President [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Rafael Duarte[/color][/url][color=white] refused to leave Zyxtopia during the siege and coordinated the defense from inside its walls. He is the only president of the Free States remembered with some affection.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE LOCUST[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The war was decided in one week of August. Automa had never shown the [/color][color=white][b]Locust[/b][/color][color=white] to anyone: two million small drones that needed no pilot, talked to each other and chose their own targets. Released over the desert, they found the Union columns faster than any radar and did not stop until there was nothing left to find. It was the first autonomous swarm ever used in a war. Every army in the world has one now. Los Vales sells them.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]DESTRUCTION[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Bubblepedia counts about 1.6 million Valian dead, 1.3 million of them civilians, and about 420,000 Union soldiers. The country lost more people in nine months than in every other war of its history together.[/color]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CONSEQUENCES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Union withdrew without what it came for. When the smoke cleared, the ruins, the money and the reconstruction all belonged to the corporations. In 2050 Duarte and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] launched the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834884][color=#7FDBFF]Rebirth Plan[/color][/url][color=white] — total economic freedom, rebuilt cities, open borders — and millions came. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] paid for most of it. Nobody asked what it wanted in return.[/color]

[color=white]The Union has never signed a peace. In 2088 it still wants the West back, and the general who leads it, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]Marcus Holt[/color][/url][color=white], is the son of the general who lost.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]A BET ON CHAOS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 1985 [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF]Kobe Portenova[/color][/url][color=white] bought a small town in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Sonora[/color][/url][color=white], renamed it Hermosa and offered the world no taxes and no rules. It grew fast and dirty. Gangs took the streets, and in 1993 the [/color][color=white][b]Hermosa Massacre[/b][/color][color=white] killed Portenova and sent thousands of refugees down [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69[/color][/url][color=white] — the people who would build [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Dulces[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CAPITAL[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 1999 the corporations hired [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white], which wiped out the gangs in months and made Hermosa its home. The city became the capital of the State of Los Vales and then of the Republic, with WM’s skyscraper as its tallest building.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE DOLPHIN YEARS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]From 2016 the preacher-mayor [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF]Tomas Dolphin[/color][/url][color=white], funded by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]ArmaTech[/color][/url][color=white], banned alcohol and drugs and turned the freest city in the country into a moral prison. Riots followed. From 2019 ArmaTech hackers fought a silent war inside WM, whose headquarters stood in the middle of the chaos.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE NIGHT IT EVAPORATED[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2022 ArmaTech’s hackers took control of a warhead being flown from the roof of WM’s tower. The security system, designed so that no warhead would ever be captured, read the hack as a theft and did what it was built to do. Almost two million people, President [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Samuel Reyes[/color][/url][color=white] and half the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Corporate Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] died in one second.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]LAST GUARD[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The system that destroyed Hermosa was WM’s pride: [/color][color=white][b]Last Guard[/b][/color][color=white], the first autonomous defense ever allowed to destroy what it protects rather than let it be stolen. It worked exactly as designed. It was the first time a security machine killed its own owner, and two million people with it. After 2022 every autonomous weapon in the world was given a human hand on the final decision. Except in Los Vales.[/color]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE CRATER[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Hermosa is a crater 2.3 km wide where the WM tower stood. The burned and poisoned suburbs around it became the home of the Sleepers of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Universalia[/color][/url][color=white], and a column of refugees walked north on Route 69 to the half-built city that became [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]AFTER[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The survivors who could walk built Ferox. The ones who stayed were given [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Eferverso[/color][/url][color=white] and woke up in Universalia. In 2026 the death of the city was announced by a network born that same year: the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white]. In 2088 [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Portenova Corp[/color][/url][color=white] is rumored to be planning [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF][b]Hermosa Real[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the rebuilding of the true city.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=Why the warhead was moving][color=white]WM said it was flying the warhead out of Hermosa because of the riots. Bubble’s sources say otherwise: the warhead was sold. The buyer was Zyx, which had opened its first laboratory a year earlier and wanted a deterrent of its own. Nobody at Zyx has ever explained why it would need one.[/color][/spoiler]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]1. NAME[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The name comes from the Spanish [/color][color=white][i]los valles[/i][/color][color=white], "the valleys", the dry valleys of the old Southwest where the first casino towns were built. In Spanish a [/color][color=white][i]vale[/i][/color][color=white] is also a voucher, a written promise to pay — a meaning Valians rarely forget. The country was the [/color][color=white][b]State of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] (2000–2013), the [/color][color=white][b]Republic of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white] (2013–2028) and, since the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832690][color=#7FDBFF]bankruptcy of 2028[/color][/url][color=white], the [/color][color=white][b]Free States of Los Vales[/b][/color][color=white]. "Free" refers to the market, not to the citizens.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]2. NATIONAL SYMBOLS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The symbols of Los Vales were chosen in the dark years of the Thirst, when the country needed something to sell to itself. The [/color][color=white][b]Neon Girl[/b][/color][color=white] of the coat of arms comes from the first neon signs of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Noites[/color][/url][color=white], where she lay above the casino doors in the 1990s; the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] made her official in 2057, together with the motto. The [/color][color=white][b]demon pitaya[/b][/color][color=white], the red star of the old flags, is the national fruit — it has been blue since [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832687][color=#7FDBFF]ALCHACAL[/color][/url][color=white] changed its colour, and nobody changed the flag. [size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]3. HISTORY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][i]Main articles: [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999865][color=#7FDBFF][i]History of Los Vales[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834986][color=#7FDBFF][i]Bubblepedia: Who Owns Whom[/i][/color][/url]

[color=white]In less than a century Los Vales went from an empty desert of the old American West to the richest country on Earth: a corporate state (2000), a republic won with forgotten nuclear warheads (2013), a bankrupt republic handed to its creditors (2028), and the Free States of the corporations ever since.[/color]

[color=white][b]Before the state (to 1995)[/b][/color]

[color=white]The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white] desert was the land of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Xinko-Xenko[/color][/url][color=white], who formed a confederation in 1881 with its capital at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Koxez-Kaya[/color][/url][color=white] and guarded the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832745][color=#7FDBFF]Xunaya[/color][/url][color=white], a cactus flower whose tea let a whole village share one dream. The industrial East, ruled since the 19th century by the doctrine of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#7FDBFF]Edward Whitmore[/color][/url][color=white] and by railroad and arms giants such as the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832544][color=#7FDBFF]Blackstones[/color][/url][color=white], left the West empty.[/color]

[color=white]After 1945 the United States used it to test atomic weapons. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69[/color][/url][color=white] opened in 1976, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF]Kobe Portenova[/color][/url][color=white] founded the tax-free town of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa[/color][/url][color=white] in 1985 and Las Noites became the first casino city in 1990. When [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]NAV[/color][/url][color=white] collapsed, the Blackstones kept its arms division as [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]ArmaTech[/color][/url][color=white] and its bank as the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]The State of Desires (1999–2012)[/b][/color]

[color=white]In 1999 the chemists [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832540][color=#7FDBFF]Zachary and Xavyer[/color][/url][color=white] founded [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] in a basement of Las Noites, and the security firm [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white] cleared Hermosa of gangs. In 2000 the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834901][color=#7FDBFF]Corporate League[/color][/url][color=white] united [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Coronnel[/color][/url][color=white], [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Tampa[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Sonora[/color][/url][color=white] into the State of Los Vales, ruled by a Governor-General. Private armies fought the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF]First Corporate War[/color][/url][color=white] (2001–2006), and in 2007 Koxez-Kaya was annexed and renamed [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]La Marijuana[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white][b]The Republic (2013–2028)[/b][/color]

[color=white]When a military coup broke the United States in 2012, Los Vales declared independence; WM, holding the forgotten warheads of Coronnel, defeated the American army in 2013. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Manuella Portenova[/color][/url][color=white] led the Republic until she lost the 2014 election to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Menphis Polo[/color][/url][color=white] — the only contested election in the country's history.[/color]

[color=white]In 2022 a warhead exploded on top of the WM tower and erased Hermosa, the capital, with almost two million people. Zyx offered the survivors [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Eferverso[/color][/url][color=white], the first [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoactive Reality[/color][/url][color=white] drug. The Republic, unable to pay for the ruins, went bankrupt in 2028 and the Corporate Cabinet took full power.[/color]

[color=white]Los Vales lies on the Pacific coast of the former American West, from the industrial north of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Buffalo[/color][/url][color=white] to the mountains of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Fortuna[/color][/url][color=white]. Its interior is the [/color][color=white][b]Escaldar[/b][/color][color=white], a hot desert holding the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AquaVale[/color][/url][color=white] aquifers, the old [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]BeDay[/color][/url][color=white] oil fields, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white] labor camps and, at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Koxez-Kaya Nova[/color][/url][color=white], the last wild fields of Xunaya. A single highway, [/color][color=white][b]Route 69[/b][/color][color=white], links all seven cities; off the road there are almost no towns left.[/color]

[color=white][b]Climate.[/b][/color][color=white] Arid and getting worse. The last natural river, the Rio Colorado Novo, ran dry during the Thirst (2055–2064); rain returned only when AquaVale began seeding the clouds, and since 2085 the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832557][color=#7FDBFF]seeded rain[/color][/url][color=white] has been failing again (the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832557][color=#7FDBFF]Dry Drought[/color][/url][color=white]). [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] lives under permanent smog. Water is sold by the liter.[/color]

It exports metal from space, robots, weapons, implants, films and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverses[/color][/url][color=white], and imports little but grain and chips. [color=white]The Port of Ferox and the Ferox Spaceport carry almost all foreign trade. [size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]11. DEMOGRAPHICS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][i]Main articles: [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF][i]Events & Life[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832718][color=#7FDBFF][i]Growing Up in Los Vales[/i][/color][/url]

[color=white]About [/color][color=white][b]233 million[/b][/color][color=white] people live in Los Vales, almost all of them in the seven metropolises. The country grew through immigration: Americans fleeing the East, Latin Americans through the casino towns, Japanese settlers in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama State[/color][/url][color=white] in the 2000s and, since 2083, refugees at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]the Wall[/color][/url][color=white], many of whom end up in Lockwell's camps. The Xinko-Xenko are the only indigenous people; fewer than ever, they live deep in the Escaldar.[/color]

[color=white]The deepest division is not ethnic but mental: the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF][b]Connected[/b][/color][/url][color=white] live mostly inside a Psychoverse, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF][b]Awake[/b][/color][/url][color=white] never entered or managed to leave, the [/color][color=white][b]Converts[/b][/color][color=white] live in artificial bodies and cannot dream. [color=white][b]School and work[/b][/color]

[color=white]There are almost no public schools. Elite schools carry [/color][color=white][b]Conduct Clauses[/b][/color][color=white]; the free schools of the outskirts carry nothing — "free" meaning unprotected. Shifts of twelve hours are normal, and part of many wages is paid in company money.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[color=white][b]Health[/b][/color]

Rescue is sold by Halo Response — Halo Silver costs 39 CR a month — and Halo ambulances do not stop for people without a plan. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832687][color=#7FDBFF]Fresh Air Co[/color][/url][color=white] sells breathable air in Ferox, where respiratory disease is the leading cause of death.[/color]

[color=white][b]Getting around[/b][/color]

In Ferox the workers sleep between shifts in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]RestBox[/color][/url][color=white] capsules, at 4 CR an hour.[/color]
